questions.content: Methods of chemical separation are of great importance in industrial processes and in day to day life. As chemistry student planning to become an industry personnel, explain the application of different method of separating mixtures in daily life and industries life and in industries. Given six (6) points.

media.alt: Complete unchanged Chemistry source paper page 6.

questions.answerKey: Examples: filtration removes solids during water treatment or pharmaceutical processing; distillation purifies liquids or separates petroleum fractions; evaporation obtains salt from sea water; chromatography separates dye components or supports product-quality analysis; solvent extraction obtains oils from seeds; magnetisation removes iron contamination; decantation separates immiscible layers; sieving sorts particles; crystallisation purifies suitable solids. Explain any six applications with examples.
questions.markingGuide: Source introduction 1.5 marks, any six correct explained applications at 2 marks each (12), conclusion 1.5 marks, total 15. Accept other appropriate methods/applications. Independent examples avoid claiming that all distillation alone guarantees drinking-water safety.
